name: Six of Wands
prompt:

Preserve the composition, figures, clothing, faces, poses, horse if present, border if present, blank title area, background, colors, delicate ink style, texture, proportions and all other objects exactly. Do not redraw the scene or change the palette. Wands are long single unbranched rods, distinct and countable; no duplicates hidden in decorative lines. No text or new ornaments. Return the complete portrait card illustration at the same high resolution.
correction: Only five upright wands visible. Add one more clearly separate upright wand in the procession, so there are exactly six including the wreath-topped wand.
